events.description: Rachel Green says Ross Geller should remember when Rachel Green and Ross Geller went to Central Park and rented boats.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green and Ross Geller went to Central Park and rented boats, and that the Central Park boats trip was fun.
Ross Geller says Alan could row like a viking during the Central Park boats trip.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller's meeting has happened and asks how it went.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller knows how Monica Geller's meeting went.
Phoebe Buffay asks whether Alan mentioned Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing.
Monica Geller says Alan said that Alan is really going to miss Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller has had a rough day.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller should come here.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing has reached his limit.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is going to get cigarettes.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not care, that the attempt to quit smoking is over, that Chandler Bing is weak, and that Chandler Bing has to smoke and have a cigarette.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing must never smoke again.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay will give Chandler Bing seven thousand dollars if Chandler Bing never smokes again.
